Biowasm and Aioli
=================
The Aioli runner (aioli.js) and the base module (base/1.0.0/) come from the Biowasm project
(https://biowasm.com, https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm and https://github.com/biowasm/aioli),
and so do the WebAssembly builds of GNU coreutils, gawk, grep 3.7 and sed in this folder. The
other programs here are not Biowasm builds: diff and cmp (diffutils/3.10/) and the grep that
carries out "grep -P" (grep/3.11/, GNU grep with PCRE2) were compiled for the course.

The licence below is that of Biowasm and Aioli themselves. It does not relicense the programs:
each program keeps its own licence, which is in its folder (NAME/VERSION/) together with a
NOTICE.txt. (The folder of the base module, base/1.0.0/, has a notice and checksums only: its
licence is the one below.)

aioli.js is Aioli 3.2.3 (npm package @biowasm/aioli; its dist/aioli.js is the same file as that
of 3.2.2) as the Biowasm CDN serves it, https://biowasm.com/cdn/v3/aioli.js, with local changes.
The local changes to the runner and the programs are listed in RUNTIME-PATCHES.txt;
execio-source.txt is the readable source of the code added to the runner's worker. SHA256SUMS
lists the four files at the top of this folder.

Comlink and wasm-feature-detect
===============================
aioli.js includes Comlink (https://github.com/GoogleChromeLabs/comlink), the library that
carries the calls between the page and the worker in which the programs run, and the check for
WebAssembly SIMD of wasm-feature-detect (https://github.com/GoogleChromeLabs/wasm-feature-detect).
Their source files state:

    Comlink:             Copyright 2019 Google LLC
                         SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
    wasm-feature-detect: Copyright 2019 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.
                         Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0

The text of the Apache License, Version 2.0 is in ../licenses/Apache-2.0.txt. Both are used
unmodified, as bundled into aioli.js by the Aioli project (Aioli 3.2.3 depends on Comlink ^4.3.1
and wasm-feature-detect ^1.2.11; the bundler removed the comments above from the file).

The programs
============
Program (folder)                 Licence
base/1.0.0                       MIT (the Biowasm licence above)
coreutils/8.32 (17 programs)     GNU GPL version 3 or later
diffutils/3.10 (diff, cmp)       GNU GPL version 3 or later – compiled for the course
gawk/5.1.0                       GNU GPL version 3 or later
grep/3.7                         GNU GPL version 3 or later
grep/3.11 (grep-perl)            GNU GPL version 3 or later; with PCRE2 10.42 (BSD 3-clause with
                                 the PCRE2 exemption, PCRE2-LICENCE) – compiled for the course
sed/4.8                          GNU GPL version 3 or later

The source code and build recipes of these programs are in ../licenses/ (see
../licenses/README.txt). Each .wasm file also contains parts of the Emscripten runtime and of its
C library, musl, and the compiler support functions of LLVM's compiler-rt where a program needs
them; the JavaScript loaders were written by Emscripten. The licence texts of these are in
../licenses/runtime-libraries/. All the programs here are written in C: none contains a C++
library, and none contains zlib, bzip2 or liblzma.
